title: Soccerway — Grokipedia
content: Soccerway is a digital platform offering comprehensive coverage of association football (soccer), including live scores, fixtures, results, league tables, player statistics, transfers, and match analysis for thousands of competitions worldwide.](#ref-1) Launched in 2000 as a merger of two early soccer websites—International Soccer Server (started in 1994 as a hobby project in Finland) and SoccerWay (launched in 1995 in the Netherlands)—Soccerway combines extensive results databases with news and entertainment features to serve global fans.](#ref-2) The platform covers thousands of competitions, spanning major European competitions like the English Premier League and Spanish LaLiga, as well as international, youth, women's, and lower-division matches from regions including Africa, Asia, and the Americas.](#ref-1) It also provides betting odds, head-to-head comparisons, and archives dating back over 20 years for select leagues.](#ref-1) Operated from the Czech Republic, Soccerway is wholly owned by Livesport Group a.s., with ultimate beneficial owners Martin Hájek and Jiří Mareš, and it extends its services through a mobile app featuring push notifications and highlights for top leagues such as the UEFA Champions League and Bundesliga.](#ref-3) Targeting millions of users, the site emphasizes user-friendly navigation and detailed data to enhance fan engagement, while competing with platforms like Flashscore and OneFootball in the sports media landscape.](#ref-1).
